title: IISER Pune timetable - day, time, room

fields.day: Weekday as printed in the timetable
fields.time: Time the class occupies. Normally the time column it is printed in; widened when the PDF states a longer duration (e.g. "(4-6pm)", "(12-1:30)", "(14:00-16:55)") or the cell is merged across columns (labs 15:00-17:55)
fields.room_number: Room(s) as printed in that entry's own Room No. cell, comma-separated; null when the PDF prints no room
fields.course_code: Course code as printed (null for the Colloquium)
fields.course_name: Course name as printed, including tutorial/batch remarks
fields.slot: Slot letter (A-K) or label (Lab 1, Lab 2, Extra lab slot) from the day's header row
fields.kind: lecture | tutorial | lab | event | reserved (derived from the printed name/slot label)

Rebuilt from the PDF and checked cell by cell against zoomed images of every day block in all three year groups.
Each entry is one course in one time column; several courses share a time column, each with its own room, so day+time alone is not unique.
Rooms printed with a missing separator or split across lines (e.g. "LHC304", "101,103" then "105,...") are normalised to "LHC 304", "LHC 101, LHC 103, LHC 105, ...".
Where the PDF prints no room (Year I lab/computing blocks, Lab 1/Lab 2 practicals, Colloquium, MT5114 & MT5124, EC3164 on Tuesday) room_number is null.
Cross-listed codes keep both parts, e.g. BI3134/DS3114.
Inferred (not printed) items: the 18:55 end of TD3113; the room "G1" for EC4164 on Monday; the completed name of CH4164 on Friday. Each carries a note.
